description: Brush keys in real Positron: with the brush tool active, ] grows the brush and does not rotate the map; with the brush off, ] rotates the map.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
k = rng.integers(0, 4, 3000)
df = pd.DataFrame(rng.normal(0, 1, (3000, 8)) + k[:, None] * 4, columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(8)])
df['cluster'] = [f'c{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: brush tool on
steps.eval: a.setAnnotateTool('brush'); window.__size0 = a.brush.sizePx; window.__rot0 = a.rotation2D; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));

steps.name: ] grows the brush and does not rotate
brush tool off
steps.eval: a.setAnnotateTool(null); window.__rot1 = a.rotation2D; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
